label: Lamassu type II system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a locus with an additional LmuC component alongside the LmuA effector module and SMC-like LmuB sensor.
observations: LmuC-containing component class, not a length clade or fixed gene count. See proposal.md for HNH, SMEK and Hydrolase-Protease subclass refinements.
